title: Gargantua
summary: A relativistic WebGL2 GLSL raymarched black hole with Schwarzschild gravitational lensing, Doppler-shifted accretion disk, and tidal disruption.
description: A real-time WebGL2 GLSL observation and 30-second flight descending from a polar view into the equatorial plane of an incandescent accretion disk around Gargantua as a blue-gold star undergoes tidal disruption past an orbiting telemetry probe.
